- `2 × 10s + 4 × 5s` — six beats. A slow open and close around a quicker middle (Recommended).
- `4 × 10s` — four long held beats. Slow, quiet, post-apocalyptic mood.
- `8 × 5s` — eight quick beats. Busiest, most cutting energy.
- `1 × 10s + 6 × 5s` — seven beats. One long opening beat, then brisk movement.
- `3 × 10s + 2 × 5s` — five beats. Very slow and contemplative.

concept: Two surviving cut-paper cats navigate the quiet, ruined metro station after the war.
style_bible: Handcrafted layered paper-cutout stop motion photographed on a tabletop diorama rig. Built from cold-press textured cardstock, rough tan kraft paper, charcoal-grey board, rust-brown cardstock, muted ochre paper, aged cream paper, and translucent vellum haze sheets. Every paper element stands a few millimetres in front of the next, casting soft contact shadows. Edges are hand-cut with a craft knife, crisp but slightly irregular, revealing the pale paper core along cut edges. Paper sheets exhibit subtle physical warping and surface tooth. Animation is strictly on twos with visible step-wise joints. Zero digital gradients, zero 3D renders, zero airbrushing, zero glowing light effects, zero floating particles, zero dialogue, and zero text. RECURRING CHARACTERS: (1) Black Cat Puppet: sleek matte-black cardstock cat puppet with glossy black pin-head bead eyes, sharp pointed ears, thin black ink inner outlines, and brass split pins at shoulder, hip, and tail joints. (2) Tabby Cat Puppet: scruffy tabby cat puppet cut from heavy textured tan kraft paper with charcoal-grey cut-paper stripes, a distinct notched left ear, glossy black pin-head bead eyes, a pink cardstock nose cutout, and brass split pins at shoulder and hip joints. RECURRING WORLD ELEMENTS: Concrete wreckage cut from charcoal-grey cold-press board; metro tunnel entrance cut from solid deep indigo paper; rusted steel beams and turnstile arms cut from rust-brown cardstock; platform edge with yellow tactile paving strip cut from muted ochre paper. PALETTE: Charcoal grey, deep indigo, rust brown, tan kraft, muted ochre, pale slate-blue, aged cream. LIGHTING: Single directional cool key lamp from upper left raking across paper surfaces to highlight texture and cast soft shadows onto background planes; muted indigo fill from lower right. VERTICAL 9:16 PORTRAIT FRAMING.
